dct_description_sm: The Russian IPY Science Plan for 2007-2008 includes investigations at the meso-scale polygon in the vicinity of the North Pole to carry out physical, chemical and biological measurements of the Transarctic sea ice out-flow (e.g. transport of water mass, snow/ice thickness, nutrients, contaminants and biological tracers). This dataset describes the zooplankton communities of the North Pole region.
dct_title_s: Zooplankton inventory of the North Pole (2007-2012)
